data.body:
[P1] Require retirement reconciliation for unjournaled invocations

If an adapter launches work without calling `record_attempt`, ownership validation correctly rejects the collected evidence, but the empty journal makes this guard skip retirement auditing. Final validation is also skipped because the case no longer passes. Consequently, `retire` returning `True` releases the target even when collected evidence contains an unsettled execution. Require reconciliation whenever evidence reveals launched work, and quarantine invocations that cannot be bound to the journal. Add a regression with an empty journal and nonempty collected attempts.
